The '''Khramboa system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region, in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Arrowhead" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Khramboan/Legends|Khramboan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EvilPlans" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Khramboa [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
